Based on my analysis of the Precision Labs CRM and support data, there are **9 Enterprise accounts** renewing in the next 60 days that currently have open critical (P1) tickets. 

### **Renewing Enterprise Accounts with Open P1 Tickets**

| Account Name | ID | Renewal Date | P1 Ticket Subject | Category | Relevant KB Articles |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Granite Systems** | CUST-0005 | 2026-10-07 | Data pipeline drop after platform update | Integration | **KB-0020**: API Migration Guide |
| **Wavelength Group** | CUST-0353 | 2026-11-01 | OAuth token refresh loop on SCIM connector | Integration | **KB-0018**: API Authentication |
| **Latticework Labs** | CUST-0391 | 2026-10-20 | Bulk export stalling on datasets > 50k rows | Performance | **KB-0015**: Troubleshooting Bulk Export |
| **Sablefield Co** | CUST-0412 | 2026-10-20 | API rate limit documentation unclear | API | **KB-0071, KB-0045**: API Rate Limits |
| **Vertex Networks** | CUST-0220 | 2026-10-22 | Zapier integration timing out | Integration | **KB-0009**: Zapier Integration |
| **Solace Analytics** | CUST-0179 | 2026-11-07 | HubSpot field mapping errors | Integration | **KB-0009**: Zapier/Automation |
| **Vertex Technologies**| CUST-0439 | 2026-11-01 | Onboarding checklist priorities | Onboarding | **KB-0001**: Workspace Setup |
| **Redwood Networks** | CUST-0027 | 2026-11-19 | User invites failing | Bug | **KB-0003**: RBAC & Permissions |
| **Solace Partners** | CUST-0088 | 2026-11-27 | Search latency spike since deployment | Performance | **KB-0098**: Dashboard Performance |

### **Key Findings & Next Steps**
1.  **High-Risk Renewals**: Accounts like **Granite Systems** and **Fathom Networks** (renewal date Oct 1-2) are imminent. The "Data pipeline drop" for Granite Systems is particularly critical as it involves a platform update.
2.  **Recurring Themes**: 
    *   **Integration Issues**: 5 out of 9 accounts are struggling with integrations (HubSpot, SCIM, Zapier, Pipelines).
    *   **Performance/Scaling**: Both **Latticework Labs** and **Solace Partners** are experiencing performance degradation (exports stalling and search latency).
3.  **KB Recommendations**: 
    *   For technical API/Integration issues, direct CSMs to the **API v1 to v2 Migration Guide (KB-0020)** and **Authentication (KB-0018)**.
    *   For performance issues, **KB-0015** specifically addresses stalling exports, which is the exact issue for Latticework Labs.

I recommend the Customer Success Managers (Ji-Woo Kang, Marcus Webb, Omar Haddad, etc.) review these KB articles immediately to assist in resolving these tickets before the renewal dates.
